title: docs(plugin-chatbot): useAgents' shape table said the servers are unenveloped — they are not (objectstack#4053)
body:
Companion to objectstack#4238, closing out objectstack#4053.

## What was wrong

`extractAgentList` was written *ahead* of the server conversion (objectui#2992), and its docstring froze that moment:

> This route … **is mid-migration** onto the platform's declared `{ success: true, data }` envelope …
> `{ agents: [ … ]  }` — **today's shape, both producers**
> Reading the envelope **BEFORE any producer emits it** is deliberate …

None of that is true now. Both producers converted — the framework's degraded fallback in objectstack#4124, cloud's `service-ai` in cloud#929 — so `{ agents }` is not "today's shape, both producers"; it is nobody's shape on a current server.

## What changed

Comments and test names only. The four-shape table now leads with what the wire actually carries and labels the rest honestly:

```
{ success: true, data: { agents } }    what both producers serve today
{ success: true, data: [ … ] }         the envelope flattened — no producer emits it
{ agents: [ … ] }                      pre-conversion servers
[ … ]                                  a bare array
```

## Why the tolerance stays, and why saying so is the point

`extractAgentList` is unchanged — a console release is not pinned to the server it runs against, so a deployment from before the conversion is ordinary rather than hypothetical.

But "four shapes read, only one of them real" is an invitation to narrow this function, and narrowing it is uniquely unsafe *here*: an unrecognised shape does not throw, warn, or log. It yields an empty list, and `useAiSurfaceEnabled` turns an empty list into "hide the entire AI surface" — which is also the correct answer for a seat-less user (ADR-0068) and a Community Edition deployment with no `service-ai`.

| | what the user sees |
|---|---|
| seat-less user | AI surface hidden (correct) |
| CE deployment, no `service-ai` | AI surface hidden (correct) |
| a shape this function stopped reading | AI surface hidden (**the bug**) |

So the docstring now says outright not to read the legacy branches as evidence the servers are bare, because a cleanup that "follows" the old comment would break exactly the deployments it appears to describe.

## Verification

| gate | result |
|---|---|
| `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` | **232 passed** (16 files) |
| `tsc --noEmit` | clean |

No behavior change.
